Loans & investments with regular payments定期付款的贷款与投资

Put $200 a month into a TFSA from age 18 and you have over $31000 at 28 — about $7000 of it is interest you never deposited. The same math tells you what a car loan or mortgage really costs.从 18 岁起每月往 TFSA（免税储蓄账户）存 $200，到 28 岁就超过 $31000——其中约 $7000 是你没存过的利息。同一套数学也告诉你车贷、房贷真正要花多少。

Difficulty难度 ●●●
⏱ 45 min · ★ essential必会

🔑 Must know必须记住 · Loans & investments with regular payments定期付款的贷款与投资
  1. Saving with equal deposits → FV. Loan → amount borrowed is PV; solve for PMT.定期等额存款 → 求终值 FV。贷款 → 借款额是现值 PV，求每期还款 PMT。
  2. i = rate per PAYMENT period, n = number of payments (monthly, 5 years → n=60).i＝每个还款期的利率，n＝还款次数（按月 5 年 → n=60）。
  3. Interest = total paid − amount borrowed (or − total deposited).利息＝总付款 − 借款额（储蓄则 − 总存入）。
FV=PMT⋅i(1+i)n−1​
PV=PMT⋅i1−(1+i)−n​

🧗 The hard part难点 · Loans & investments with regular payments定期付款的贷款与投资

Canadian mortgage: semi-annual compounding, monthly payments加拿大房贷：半年复利、按月还款

Compounding and payment periods differ, so r/12 is wrong — you need the equivalent monthly rate.计息期和还款期不同，r/12 是错的——要用等价月利率。

  1. Half-year rate: 20.04​=0.02半年利率：20.04​=0.02
  2. Equivalent monthly: i=(1.02)1/6−1≈0.0033059等价月利率：i=(1.02)1/6−1≈0.0033059
  3. n=300; PMT=1−(1+i)−nPV⋅i​n=300；PMT=1−(1+i)−nPV⋅i​
  4. TVM does steps 1–2 if P/Y =12, C/Y =2.在 TVM 里设 P/Y =12、C/Y =2，前两步自动完成。
Try试一试
Find the monthly payment on a $200000 mortgage at 4% compounded semi-annually, amortized over 25 years.$200000 房贷，年利率 4%、半年复利，25 年摊还，求每月还款。
Answer答案
≈$1052.04 per month (using r/12 would wrongly give $1055.67).每月约 $1052.04（错用 r/12 会得到 $1055.67）。

⚠️ Traps & tip陷阱与提示 · Loans & investments with regular payments定期付款的贷款与投资
  • i=0.069 for monthly payments ✗ → i=0.069/12, n in months.按月还款用 i=0.069 ✗ → i=0.069/12，n 按月计。
  • Total of payments = interest ✗ → subtract the amount borrowed.把还款总额当利息 ✗ → 要减去借款额。
🎯
TVM Solver: money out negative, money in positive; set P/Y and C/Y first (Canadian mortgage C/Y =2).TVM 求解器：付出为负、收到为正；先设好 P/Y 和 C/Y（加拿大房贷 C/Y =2）。

cards.f: TVM: what do N, I%, PV, PMT, FV mean?TVM：N、I%、PV、PMT、FV 各是什么？
cards.b: Number of payments, annual rate %, present value, payment each period, future value.付款次数、年利率（%）、现值、每期付款、终值。

cards.f: P/Y and C/Y for a Canadian mortgage paid monthly?按月还款的加拿大房贷，P/Y 与 C/Y？
cards.b: P/Y =12, C/Y =2.P/Y =12，C/Y =2。

cards.f: Savings plan → which formula?储蓄计划用哪个公式？
cards.b: FV=PMT⋅i(1+i)n−1​

cards.f: Loan → which formula?贷款用哪个公式？
cards.b: PMT=1−(1+i)−nPV⋅i​

cards.f: Total interest on a loan?贷款的总利息？
cards.b: PMT×n−PV.PMT×n−PV。

quiz.q: You save $100 a month for 3 years at 4% compounded monthly. On a TVM solver, what is N?你每月存 $100，存 3 年，年利率 4% 按月复利。在 TVM 计算器上 N 是多少？
opts: 3
12
36
4
quiz.hint: N counts payments, not years.N 数的是付款次数，不是年数。
quiz.ans: N =36
quiz.why: 12×3=36 monthly payments.12×3=36 次月付款。

quiz.q: Find the future value of $100 deposited at the end of each month for 3 years at 4% compounded monthly.每月月底存 $100，存 3 年，年利率 4% 按月复利。求终值。
quiz.hint: i=0.04/12, n=36.i=0.04/12，n=36。
quiz.ans: $3818.16
quiz.why: FV=100⋅0.04/12(1+0.04/12)36−1​≈3818.16.FV=100⋅0.04/12(1+0.04/12)36−1​≈3818.16。

quiz.q: An $8000 loan at 7.5% compounded monthly is repaid monthly over 3 years. Find the payment and the total interest.$8000 贷款，年利率 7.5% 按月复利，3 年按月还清。求月供和总利息。
quiz.hint: i=0.075/12=0.00625, n=36.i=0.075/12=0.00625，n=36。
quiz.ans: $248.85 per month; interest $958.60月供 $248.85；利息 $958.60
quiz.why: PMT=1−(1.00625)−368000(0.00625)​≈248.85.PMT=1−(1.00625)−368000(0.00625)​≈248.85。

quiz.q: You can afford $350 a month for 4 years. At 6% compounded monthly, what is the largest loan you can take?你每月能还 $350，还 4 年。年利率 6% 按月复利，最多能借多少？
opts: $16800.00
$14903.11
$18934.24
$13200.00
quiz.hint: Present value: PV=350⋅0.0051−(1.005)−48​.现值：PV=350⋅0.0051−(1.005)−48​。
quiz.ans: $14903.11
quiz.why: PV≈14903.11. (350×48=16800 is what you pay in total, not what you can borrow.)PV≈14903.11。（350×48=16800 是还款总额，不是能借的金额。）

quiz.q: You want $50000 for a down payment in 5 years. At 4.2% compounded monthly, how much must you deposit at the end of each month?你想 5 年后攒够 $50000 首付。年利率 4.2% 按月复利，每月月底要存多少？
quiz.hint: Solve FV formula for PMT: PMT=(1+i)n−1FV⋅i​.由终值公式解出 PMT：PMT=(1+i)n−1FV⋅i​。
quiz.ans: $750.35
quiz.why: i=0.0035, n=60: PMT=1.003560−150000(0.0035)​≈750.35.i=0.0035，n=60：PMT=1.003560−150000(0.0035)​≈750.35。

quiz.q: You invest $2000 at the end of every year for 20 years at 6% compounded annually. Find the future value and the interest earned.每年年底投资 $2000，共 20 年，年利率 6% 按年复利。求终值和所得利息。
quiz.hint: i=0.06, n=20.i=0.06，n=20。
quiz.ans: $73571.18; interest $33571.18$73571.18；利息 $33571.18
quiz.why: FV=2000⋅0.061.0620−1​≈73571.18.FV=2000⋅0.061.0620−1​≈73571.18。

quiz.q: A $300000 mortgage at 4.5% compounded semi-annually is amortized over 25 years with monthly payments. Find the monthly payment.房贷 $300000，年利率 4.5% 半年复利，25 年摊还，按月还款。求月供。
quiz.hint: i=1.02251/6−1; or TVM with C/Y =2.i=1.02251/6−1；或在 TVM 中设 C/Y =2。
quiz.ans: $1660.42
quiz.why: i=1.02251/6−1≈0.0037153, n=300.i=1.02251/6−1≈0.0037153，n=300。

quiz.q: A couple takes a $400000 mortgage at 5% per year compounded semi-annually, paid monthly. The bank offers a 25-year amortization or a 20-year amortization. (a) Find the monthly payment for each option. (b) Find the total interest for each and how much the 20-year option saves. (c) The extra monthly payment is how much? Decide which option you would recommend for a family whose budget can handle at most $2500 a month, and justify it.一对夫妇办理 $400000 房贷，年利率 5%、每半年复利一次、按月还款。银行提供 25 年或 20 年的摊还期。(a) 分别求两种方案的月供。(b) 分别求总利息，以及 20 年方案节省多少。(c) 月供多出多少？若这家人的预算每月最多负担 $2500，你会推荐哪个方案？说明理由。
quiz.hint: Use i=(1+0.05/2)2/12−1≈0.004124, with n=300 and n=240.用 i=(1+0.05/2)2/12−1≈0.004124，n=300 和 n=240。
quiz.ans: (a) $2326.42 and $2628.50; (b) interest $297926 and $230840, saving about $67086; (c) $302.08 more per month; the 25-year option, since $2628.50>$2500.(a) $2326.42 与 $2628.50；(b) 利息 $297926 与 $230840，约节省 $67086；(c) 每月多 $302.08；推荐 25 年方案，因为 $2628.50>$2500。
quiz.why: Monthly rate i=1.0251/6−1≈0.004124.月利率 i=1.0251/6−1≈0.004124。
